news.title: Son charged with father’s murder at DeKalb County home near elementary school
news.summary: Police said a man has been arrested in connection with the shooting death of his 65-year-old father at a home Friday.

news.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta star accused of swindling victims out of nearly $200K
news.summary: A former reality television personality is facing multiple felony charges after investigators say she played a role in a real estate fraud scheme that cost victims nearly $200,000.

news.title: ‘Love & Hip Hop’ star 'Betty Idol' arrested, accused of $200K real estate scam
news.summary: Reality TV star Salomes Jackson ("Betty Idol"), known for her appearances on Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta, was arrested in Volusia County for her alleged role in a $196,000 real estate scam.

news.title: Body found in driveway in DeKalb County, investigation underway
news.summary: A death investigation is underway after a person was reportedly found dead in the driveway of a DeKalb County home Friday morning.

news.summary: Now, investigators are asking anyone who has received services from this man and believes they may have experienced inappropriate or unwanted contact.
